item.title: Spurs win in return home to San Antonio delayed by snow, mechanical issues
item.description: SAN ANTONIO (AP) — The long, strange trip the San Antonio Spurs faced to get home from the East Coast was tiring and, at times, scary, but it turned out to be well worth the journey.
